name: Red Reaches
summary: The Red Reaches is the harsh, sunbaked southeastern coastline of the Blasted Lands. Sheltered below the jagged red cliffs, its waters are dominated by a bitter struggle between the native Rockpool murlocs and the tyrannical Bloodwash naga.

sections.title: A Shattered Peace
sections.body: Running along the ocean border of the desolate Blasted Lands, the Red Reaches provides a sharp contrast between arid red rock and pounding ocean surf. For a time, the local Rockpool murloc tribes and the Bloodwash naga dwelled alongside one another in an uneasy coexistence, united partly by their shared veneration of Neptulon, the Tidehunter. That harmony dissolved when the naga asserted brutal supremacy over the coastline, turning on their former neighbors. The naga enslaved the Rockpool tribes, forcing captive murlocs into cruel gladiatorial combat and sacrificial rites.

faq.q: Where are the Red Reaches located?
faq.answer: The Red Reaches forms the southeastern shore of the Blasted Lands, tucked beneath the towering red cliffs along the Great Sea.
The coastline is inhabited primarily by the Bloodwash naga and the Rockpool murlocs, alongside coastal wildlife like crabs.

faq.q: Why are the naga and murlocs fighting here?
faq.answer: While both groups once lived side by side and shared worship of the water elemental lord Neptulon, the Bloodwash naga betrayed the murlocs, enslaving them and sacrificing them for dark ends.

faq.q: Is there any connection between this beach and the Dark Portal?
faq.answer: The beach sits far down on the coast away from the Dark Portal, largely isolated from the demonic forces and Nethergarde mages fighting inland.

angles.text: The twisted reverence the Bloodwash naga hold toward Neptulon, Lord of Tides, stands as an affront to any shaman dedicated to maintaining balance with the Elemental Lords.
